cards.front: Total hip arthroplasty is the best long term solution for displaced femoral neck fractures (FNF) in active elderly patients .
cards.extra: THA has best pain relief, fewer reoperations, best survivorship and is most cost-effective but has longer operative/anesthetic time, blood loss, higher infection rate, and potential instability compared with hemiarthroplasty. Yu et al. (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22395872/) performed a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials to determine whether THA or hemiarthroplasty (HA) was superior. They found that THA had lower risk of reoperation (RR = 0.53), higher risk of dislocation (RR = 1.99), and higher functional scores at 1 and 4 years. There was no difference in mortality, infection and complication rates.
